2608.03866.title: ADMITBench: A Safety-Governed Reference Framework for Evaluating the Admissibility of Industrial LLM Advisories
2608.03866.paper_summary: This white paper presents ADMITBench, a reference framework for evaluating industrial LLM advisories at the level of the proposed action. The framework implements a versioned, safety-governed evaluation contract that checks whether a recommendation is supported by the available evidence, permitted under the stated authority and procedure, and acceptable under the plant-specific consequence checks encoded in the selected evaluation profile. In this report, \emph{safety-governed} means that eligibility is determined through explicit, non-compensatory checks derived from a versioned plant profile; it does not mean that the evaluator, model, or plant has been safety-certified. Release 0.1.0 is a public reference implementation for technical and research evaluation, not an authorisation for physical execution.
2608.03866.paper_summary_zh: 這份白皮書介紹了ADMITBench，一個用於評估工業LLM建議的參考框架，評估的層級為所提議的行動。該框架實施了一個版本化的、安全治理的評估合約，檢查建議是否有可用證據支持，是否在所述的權限和程序下被允許，以及是否在所選評估配置檔中編碼的特定於工廠的後果檢查下是可接受的。在本報告中，\emph{safety-governed}的意思是，合格性是通過從版本化的工廠配置檔中派生的明確的、非補償性檢查來確定的；這並不意味著評估者、模型或工廠已經獲得安全認證。版本0.1.0是用於技術和研究評估的公共參考實現，而不是實體執行的授權。
